commits.summary: Freeze action discovery and register transfer cases (verification pending)
commits.body:
Freeze the public action search on TrainingStock before the JGraphT holdout. Register Guava direct and composed hex parsing, independent MutableFloat operands and a three-worker shared monitor. Compare native, model checker and original JVM separately. The exact JVM hex censuses, 100081 float pairs, one mask-zero replay and all three example replays passed. All 59 changed test groups passed, with the performance group passing on retry.

Jobs 20261123-225413-measure-guava-direct-null-boxed-and-comp, 20261123-225413-compare-guava-parser-properties-under-bo, 20261123-225414-measure-two-independent-mutablefloat-ope, 20261123-225414-check-the-full-paired-float-comparator-a, 20261123-225414-measure-strict-native-entry-on-all-three, 20261123-225415-check-atomic-split-and-terminal-assertio and 20261123-225415-discover-and-replay-every-three-worker-m preserve the independent baselines. Jobs 20261123-230231-check-javaparser-traversal-in-fresh-sepa and 20261123-230231-check-xz-frame-bytes-and-cache-identity exercise the same system property read across two independent families, including fresh-process failure and repeated use.
